transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this week's sustainment huddle started. We have 5,000 gallons of potable water scheduled for the coming week. Standard requests are on the board: 1,300 for the dining facility, 1,100 for sanitation, 900 for the motor pool, and 400 for the clinic. That totals 3,700 gallons, leaving 1,300 as contingency reserve. Before I post the distribution plan, I need each activity representative to provide a formal update if your requirements have changed. If no changes are reported, I'll approve the standard allocations as listed.
